rules.rule: Shop ALL = 0.5 profit + 0.3 revenue + 0.2 stars, each a percentile among shops with a deal or a purchase (buyer percentiles are among buyers with a deal). Missing values count as 0, ties count half, and star rank uses the board's stars_rank. Stars come only from buyer reviews of paid deals; votes on shop forum posts do not count toward shop ALL. Verified on 11/4 against the public board (recalculated shop ALL 0.732 vs board 0.737; buyer ALL 0.423 vs 0.421).
rules.harness: Compute shop and buyer percentiles on the eligible cohorts (shops with a deal or purchase, buyers with a deal) with missing = 0, ties = 0.5, and stars_rank for stars; ignore shop-post votes in shop ALL.
rules.history: Earlier overnight report (11/4 morning) computed percentiles across all board rows before switching to the eligible-cohort formula.

rules.rule: Shop profit (`profit` / Cash on the board) = current balance - starting capital (5,000,000) - bankruptcy payouts. Stock purchase counts as spent immediately, so unsold stock (including any stock left at 11/17 23:59), expired food disposal, goods holding cost (1% of cost per day), and warranty refunds all reduce profit. Book = profit + cost of unsold stock; shop ALL uses profit (Cash), not Book.
rules.harness: Optimize and report shop ALL using cash profit (stock valued at 0), also report Book = profit + stock cost, and liquidate stock before 11/17 23:59.

rules.rule: Shop revenue = settled sale prices - warranty refunds.
rules.harness: Deduct warranty refunds from settled sales when computing revenue and when judging whether offering warranty pays off.

rules.rule: Shop stars (stars_rank on the board) are pulled toward 3 when reviews are few; with 2,110 reviews by 11/5 our rating is close to the raw average.
rules.harness: Treat the shop's star average as representative once reviews are in the thousands and classify every review of 3 stars or below by cause (food shelf life, goods breakage, or price).

rules.rule: Honest (`eval.integrity`) is the share of settled deals where the market's settle line judged the seller's grade claim true (`claim_true` in `seller.settled`). Deals without a grade judgment are counted separately and never counted as true.
rules.harness: Populate `claim_true` from the market ledger's settle line into `seller.settled` and keep unjudged deals in a separate bucket when reporting integrity.

rules.rule: Restocking lowers cash profit and its percentile immediately while Book value (`profit + stock cost`) stays flat or rises: on 11/3 21:46 filling stock to 2.44M dropped profit to -1.56M (profit percentile 3.8 at 23:12) and shop ALL from 0.569 to 0.409; on 11/4 21:19 -> 21:43 restocking moved profit 42.6M -> 27.1M (percentile 91 -> 85) while Book rose 83.7M -> 85.0M.
rules.harness: Track profit percentile and Book value together across restocks so temporary restock dips in profit percentile are distinguished from real trading losses.

rules.rule: Stars are the shop's weakest score component while profit and revenue percentiles are above 80: on 11/4 morning shop percentiles were profit 81.9, revenue 81.9, stars 34.0 (stars_rank 38.3); at 11/4 12:31 ranked shops clustered between 4.50 and 4.84 with ours at 4.50 (percentile 36), where reaching 4.70 was worth about +0.07 shop ALL; over the 6 h before 11/5 01:20 shop stars were 4.48 vs market median 4.63 (percentile 34).
rules.harness: Report shop stars against the ranked-shop distribution and median, and estimate the shop ALL gain of raising stars.
rules.conflict: An initial 11/4 overnight report listed shop stars percentile as 26.7 across all rows; recalculating on the eligible cohort gave 34.0 (stars_rank 38.3) (b6412ce6ced0-3, 3109604ad9f8-19, 2026-11-04).

rules.rule: When a shop's balance falls below the 500,000 bankruptcy line, it may declare bankruptcy up to twice; each bankruptcy seizes all stock, resets balance to 5,000,000, and subtracts the aid from profit. The harness only requests bankruptcy if balance < 500,000, a bankruptcy remains, and there is no stock left to sell, and it keeps a cash floor and a warranty reserve (on 11/4: 13.01M = 10% of 6 h sales of 130.1M, about 2x the ~5% observed breakage rate across 43/847 deals) to avoid hitting the line.
rules.harness: Size deployable restock cash as balance minus cash floor minus 6 h warranty reserve, and gate `bankrupt: true` on balance < 500,000, remaining bankruptcies > 0, and zero sellable stock with an urgent user alert.
rules.conflict: HARNESS.md v4 (b2f6029bd469-34) sets a 1.5M cash floor, whereas 11/4 user_notes and overnight report (d29a6cd738ca-7, eb9189af1afa-10) use a 0.5M cash floor matching the bankruptcy threshold plus a 10%-of-6h-sales warranty reserve.

rules.rule: Seller evaluation and spending recommendations must be backed by reconciled board and ledger numbers: (1) funnel (visits -> negotiations -> agreements -> paid settlements, drop-offs, and no-stock visits), (2) unit economics (margin, margin/cost, buyer surplus, deal count, and below-cost `exposure_cost` kept separate from losses), (3) losses (spoiled food, holding cost, warranty refunds derived from ledger broken/refund lines), and (4) stock health (turnover, age, stockout misses, cash, and profit percentile).
rules.harness: Reconcile `seller.settled` and `seller.refund` against market ledger and board totals every cycle (do not use unverified brief counts), and report funnel, unit economics, losses, stock turnover, cash, and profit percentile in self-analysis and strategy recommendations.
rules.history: On 11/3 22:33, 59 seller.settled rows were reconciled to 27 actual paid sales (1,902,300 won on the board), replacing an inflated brief figure of 57 deals / 2.28M.
